payout_quote: Receive a $100 Visa Virtual Reward when your referral opens a new OUR Credit Union checking account and completes the requirements within 60 days of account opening.
steps: Be an OUR Credit Union member; log into Online Banking and find the Refer A Friend tile to start referring
Friend joins OUR Credit Union and within the first 60 days: opens a new auto loan (approved and disbursed), a new credit card, or a new checking account with requirements completed
You receive a $100 Visa Virtual Reward (friend gets $100 for auto/credit card, $200 for checking)
catches: Reward is a $100 Visa Virtual Reward, not cash
Friend must act within the first 60 days of joining: open an approved/disbursed auto loan, a credit card, or a checking account and complete the checking requirements
No published annual cap stated on the public page — see ReferLive Terms and Conditions for full program rules
Cannot be combined with any other offer
biggest_catch: Your friend must open and qualify for a real account or loan within 60 days of joining — and your $100 comes as a Visa virtual reward, not cash.
eligibility: OUR Credit Union members; referred friends must be new members acting within 60 days of joining
timing: Friend qualifies within 60 days of joining/account opening
